classification.method: PERCENTILE.INC on national known exact comparable values in the same grain and current industry/brand/format.
classification.brandFormat: Brand/format changes select the comparable supply values; these map bins do not alter the fixed national fine Demand benchmarks.
classification.intervalConvention: Lower inclusive, upper exclusive; final bin open-ended. Equal cutoffs may create explicitly empty bins.
classification.zero: Known measured zero uses first class plus explicit zero cue.
classification.reviewMissing: Neutral no-data/review cue and reason; missing or invalid values display dash, not zero.
classification.scaleReuse: GFA raw-dimensional rate reuses native built scale with explicit branch/GFA unit; it does not become building capacity. Other safe denominators declare reused scale/units explicitly.
classification.ds: Exact native LDS0.9.7 classes, full opacity, identical analytical HEX on light/dark; no inversion or opacity transformation.
classification.legend: Metric, source numerator/denominator, normalization, unit, periods, cohort/grain, known/review/missing/zero counts, numeric bin bounds and reuse policy.
